full_judgment:
2. The short facts leading to the disposal of the rule is that the opposite party Nos. 1-3 as plaintiffs tiled Title Suit No. 438 of 2009 before the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka against the petitioners as defendants for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession. The case of the plaintiff is that the original owner of the suit land was Admond Alekgender William and his name was duly recorded in C.S. khatian No. 73 and he sold that property to one Abdul Latif and he took over the property over the suit land and he died leaving behind two sons and two daughters and the predecessors of the plaintiffs Rezia khatun got Ka schedule of property by amicable settlement and she gifted schedule land to her son plaintiff Mr. Rafique Ahmed, predecessor of the plaintiffs and transferred the possession of the plaintiffs and transferred the possession of the suit land and subsequently the defendants dispossessed the plaintiffs from the floor of the suit land and claimed the suit property, hence filed the suit. 

 10. He next submits that the plaintiff case is for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession but the plaintiff stated in his application that ‘বাদিনী নালিশী সম্পত্তি ষোল আনা এককভাবে ভোগ দখলে বিদ্যমান রহিয়াছে।’ 

 11. He further submits that the suit is recovery of khas possession but the plaintiff stated in his application for local inspection that ‘কাজেই নালিশী সম্পত্তি কাহার দখলে রহিয়াছে, উহা নির্ণয় করা প্রয়োজন।’ it is a settle principle of law that ascertaining the possession of the suit land is a matter of evidence and as such the application for local inspection is not maintainable. In view of the above fact the learned Joint District Judge has committed error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in allowing the application for local inspection.
